newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- The Serbian Supreme Court endorsed the government's annulment of local elections that had given control of the capital to the opposition.
- More passengers have died on airline crashes this year than in any other, even though statistics show air travel is becoming safer over time.
- A U.S. congressman teamed with a Sudanese diplomat to persuade a rebel leader to free three Red Cross workers held hostage for 38 days in the Sudan.

- Universities are scrambling for new sources of money in the developing world to replace the dwindling support for foreign studies programs that were a greater priority of the federal government and American foundations during the cold war.

- Men's magazines, exemplified by Men's Health, are increasing their circulations by providing information on grooming, exercise, weight loss, sex appeal and other subjects long thought of as fodder for women's publications only.
